## Key Technical Projects
- ConnectDeskZ (https://github.com/RINz-HCMUS/ConnectDeskZ): Web-based remote desktop platform built with React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Tailwind CSS v4, WebRTC P2P Data Channels, and AES-256 End-to-End Encryption (E2EE).
- NetSpeedZ (https://github.com/RINz-HCMUS/NetSpeedZ): Zero-backend Internet speed and bandwidth diagnostic tool connecting client-side directly to Anycast Edge PoPs with multi-stream TCP/HTTPS, Dual-Stack IPv4/IPv6 (ASN) detection, and Bufferbloat analysis.
- WebBased-Remote-Control (https://github.com/RINz-HCMUS/WebBased-Remote-Control): Cross-platform web-based remote computer administration system built with .NET 8, C#, ASP.NET Core, and SignalR.
- NutriScan (MVP): AI-driven food barcode scanning and chemical preservative analysis web app developed with Google AI Studio, Gemini API, and Cloud Run.
